batting.dismissal: c MM Sharma b A Nehra

batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b MM Sharma

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c MA Starc b S Aravind

batting.name: MEK Hussey
batting.dismissal: c HV Patel b D Wiese

batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b HV Patel

balls.text: fuller and outside off, Aravind wants to launch it out of Ranchi but does not connect
Sarfraz perishes off the penultimate ball of the innings. Bravo slips in another slower ball outside off, he backs away for a cut. Ends up slicing it into the hands of Negi at point
fuller and on off, drilled to long-off for one

wide, Dhoni takes his time, aims at the stumps and hits it! This was a back of a length slower ball outside off, Harshal throws his bat at it and is fooled by the change of pace. He seeks a quick single. Dhoni collects the ball and effects an over-arm direct hit..
length and outside off, he does not connect with the reverse-paddle. Off the thigh and wanders away to the off side
dug in on a shortish length and outside off, slower in pace. Sarfraz waits on it before forcing it over the covers. He sat back and waited for the slower ball
low full toss on off, down the track and swung away to long-on

back of a length and on the leg stump as Sarfraz steps away and makes room. He checks his drive and sends it to short cover. Harshal is halfway down the pitch in pursuit of a quick single. The fielder does not throw the stumps down at the non-strikers'. He is caught in a dilemma whether to nail a direct hit or under-arm lob it onto the stumps. Nehra eventually runs in, looks to tip the bails off but misses. A direct hit would have consumed Harshal..
very, very, wristy! One-bounce four. On a length and on middle, he picks it up from there and flicks it aerially between deep square leg and long-on
length on off, drilled down to mid-off
shortish and outside off, flat-batted to long-on
Bravo snaffles Wiese at long-on. Back of a length and on middle, skiddy ball. Wiese goes for a lofted strike and mis-hits it to Bravo, who comes in and completes a simple catch
back of a length and outside off, slapped to backward point

Oh dear, Faf du Plessis has misjudged this, putting this down. This was on a fuller length and outside off, Wiese goes low and seeks to lap-scoop it away. He has to settle with a top-edge that swirls in the air. Faf circles under it, then moves back in an uncertain manner from short fine and drops it. The ball pops in and pops out. Faf took his eyes off the ball momentarily, it actually looked like it hit his wrists and went down on the ground
banged in short and hurries on off, he looks for a pull and gets an inside edge onto the thigh
Wiese launches it over cow corner. Length ball on off, he takes a step forward and smites it between deep midwicket and long-on. The bat made a resounding crack as it met the ball
another of those slower balls outside off, Bravo seeks to cut and chops it to the covers now
pitched up and on off, driven down to long-on for one
slower shortish ball outside off, chopped towards backward point
on a length and outside off, directed to the right of deep third man with soft hands
banged in short on off, Sarfraz arches his back and guides it to deep third man
back of a length and on off, pushed to the covers for a speedy single. Raina misses the direct hit at the strikers'. Sarfraz is in. He looks for an extra run off an overthrow but it isn't there
Nehra loses his radar, slips it down leg
good length and angled in on off, he steers it down to deep third man

DK holes out to long-on. Low full toss on middle, instead of launching it over long-on, DK scoops it straight into the hands of  Mohit, caught near chest height.. The bat twisted in his hand, foiling his timing. Kohli winces in the dug out.
Welcome back Nehra, says DK as he steps away, sits back and thrashes this full ball on off over Nehra head
Sarfraz steps away outside leg and Jadeja is wary of it as he follows him. Quietly defended
length on off, turned to the right of the bowler and he comes back for the second
nudged off the pads in front of square on the leg side
fuller and on the stumps, Sarfraz races down the track and slaps it over the bowler's head for a more authoritative four

Sarfraz makes room outside leg, Jadeja bowls this flat on leg. Sarfraz drives it inside-out over the covers even though he yanked his bottom hand off the handle. Ashwin runs across to his left in the deep but is beaten
fuller and on off, down the track and driven to long-off
full and dips in on off, milked down to long-on for a single
Negi gives this more air on middle, blocked to the right of the bowler
flat and darted on the stumps, he aims for a slog-sweep and top-edges it in front of Negi
fuller and straighter, worked to leg
flighted and Negi held this one outside off, chipped in front of covers
pushed through on the pads, Sarfraz shuffles across and works it through midwicket for a couple of runs. A direct hit from Jadeja could have put Sarfraz in trouble
darted flat on the leg stump, Sarfraz makes room and slaps it towards long-off for one
slid through quicker and hits DK on the front pad as he misses the sweep. This had pitched outside leg
Raina drifts down leg, DK employs soft hands and tickles it to the left of Dhoni. Very fine on the leg side and gets a four

six, six, wide, out! Good riposte from Raina, he snares the big wicket of Gayle. This looked like a seam-up ball from Raina on off, Gayle sets up for a pull but can only top-edge it into the air. Raina pedals back from his follow-through and settles under it near the mid-on region. Excellent judgement.
darted wide outside off, past the tram-line. Gayle does not bother with it
that's a massive blow. Pushed through on middle, Gayle extends his arms and sends it soaring over long-on into the second tier for successive sixes
Gayle goes Boom! Fuller length on middle, right in Gayle's hitting zone. He flexes his muscles and slugs it over midwicket
width on offer outside off, DK forces it to short third man
another slower ball outside off, grips in the pitch and has some extra bounce on it. DK seeks to turn to leg and is beaten
loopy slower ball on off at 103ks, DK is early into the drive and has to settle with an inside edge onto the pad
Bravo loses his radar, sprays this wide outside off. DK does not bother with it
good length ball on middle, pushed towards mid-off for a single
fuller length on middle, driven to the covers
back of a length and outside off, stops on Gayle. He seeks to cut and chops it to backward point
fuller and on off, Gayle comes down and drives it down to long-off
DK nips down the track and lofts it over mid-on. There is protection in the deep
nudged to deep square leg for a couple
on a length and outside off, DK advances down the track and smacks it over extra-cover. Aprajith flies to his left but the ball eludes him and rockets away to the boundary
fuller and on middle, DK gallops down the track and whips it over midwicket, beats the man in the deep to his left. Positive strike...
pushed through on middle and leg, worked in front of square on the leg side
pitched up and straighter in line, tapped down to long-off
short of a length and on off, DK short-arm pulls it to long-on
shortish and on the stumps, Gayle aims for a swat-pull, he does not connect. He is hit on the thigh and they sneak a leg bye
half-volley on off, Gayle crunches a drive to long-off. He comes back for the second
pitched up and on off, pushed back to the bowler. Gayle is struggling for timing and power
DK opens the face of his bat on impact with this length ball on off and glides it to deep third man
pushed through quicker, whipped away to the left of mid-on for a single, Bravo tidies up in the deep near cow corner
fullish and on off, down the track and flicked to mid-on
fuller and on middle and leg, eased to wide long-on
fired down leg, Gayle can't help it away. Wide called
slid through outside off, he switches his balance onto the back foot and cuts it away towards sweeper cover. DK wants two, Gayle isn't interested
flicked off the pads through midwicket. Gayle trots off to the other end
fuller and pushed through on middle, defended off the back foot

good length and outside off, pushed back to the bowler off an inner edge, Mohit stretches his right hand, takes some pace off it and deflects it towards mid-on. Gayle senses an opportunity and runs hard for one
pitched up and on off, DK plays a wristy drive to long-on
back of a length and just outside off, punched to backward point off the back foot
back of a length and around off, Gayle camps on the back foot and punches it down to Bravo at long-off
good length and just a shade outside off, Gayle ignores another one
fullish and outside off, another leave from Chris Gayle
pushed through on the pads, glanced to the leg side
shortish and outside off, DK goes on the back foot and cracks it to sweeper cover. He comes back for the second
pitched up and outside off, pressed to the covers
tossed up, hanging in the air and spins in to strike DK on the pad. Hit outside the line of off

Mandeep departs as RCB slip to 36 for 3. Hussey pulls off a brilliant catch. Flighted around off with some extra bounce, Madeep sinks to one knee and goes for a sweep. He mis-hits it in the air, Hussey sprints in from deep backward square leg, dives forward and takes a superb, low catch! Raina wraps Hussey in a hug...
too leg stumpish and that's glanced finer of short fine leg. Poor line and Gayle just gave it direction. He did not larrup it
back of a length and on a fourth-stump line, he camps back and punchily defends it back to the bowler
pitched up and on the pads, clipped away through square leg
good length ball on middle, Gayle is forward and across to defend it
pitched up and outside off, Mandeep is dragged into a drive, he gets an outer edge towards third man
back of a length and on off, knocked in front of short cover
fuller and on middle and leg, eased to mid-on for a quick single
tossed up offbreak, Mandeep misses the defensive push and takes it on the pad
veering onto the pads, Mandeep does not meet with the glance, the ball brushes the pad and sneaks away between Dhoni and leg-slip
flatter and on off, defended back to the bowler
pushed through on middle and leg, swept away to the leg side
tossed up on middle, pushed back to the bowler

double-strike from Nehra! Another appeal for lbw, AB has been given out now. This was another inwinger from Nehra, AB misses it and is rapped on the back pad. AB did not account for the movement here. This may have pitched outside leg.... Might have been snaking down. Tight call. Yes, it pitched just outside leg
shortish and swings back into AB, cramping the batsman for room. AB can only defend it back to Nehra
back of a length and on the hips, Gayle helps it past midwicket for one
Nehra goes up for a big lbw appeal. This was back of a length around off, strikes Gayle on the front pad just above the knee-roll. Height is an issue. Impact may have also been outside off
drifting onto the pads, tucked away behind square on the leg side for one
Nehra strikes, he gets rid of Virat Kohli. This was an innocuous ball on the hips, Kohli picks it up and flicks it straight to Mohit Sharma at short fine leg. Mohit bends forward and pouches it
Gayle lines up for a swat, Ashwin is wary of it as he fires it outside off. Gayle eventually opts to shoulder arms
fullish and on middle, patted back to the bowler
Ashwin shortens his length, punched back at the bowler
looped up generously and turning away outside off. Ashwin draws Gayle forward and beats his feeble little waft
flatter and on off, shovel-driven to long-on with plenty of bottom hand
straight roller on middle, laced to long-off
back of a length and on off, Kohli bunts it to the off side
this one's even better! He skips down the track, manufactures a length ball and launches it over Nehra's head for a flat six. Dhoni isn't pleased...
fractionally short on off, Kohli whip-pulls off the front foot to the wide long-on boundary
good length ball on off, dabbed with soft hands in front of point. Kohli aims for a speedy single but has to retreat
back of a length and on middle, worked to midwicket again
full and straight, tucked to midwicket, straight to the fielder
lobbed up on off and turns away, Gayle plays for the straighter one and pokes it out behind point
veering down leg, Gayle sweeps and helps it to the right of Nehra at short fine leg. He puts in a belated dive and his effort proves futile
slid through on the pads, worked to the left of short midwicket
flat and turning away outside off, slapped to the covers, where Jaddu takes it on his knee
looped up on off and turns away, Gayle stays back and ignores it
tossed up on middle, driven down to long-on for one
back of a length and outside off, Gayle jabs it defensively to the covers
shortish and width outside off, Gayle winds up for a massive blow and toe-ends it onto his pads. Ouch, he hops around in a bit of pain
back of a length and angled in close to off, Gayle is cautious as he ignores it
even fuller and outside off, Gayle leaves it alone

Gayle finds his bearings! Length and swings away outside off, down the track and Gayle aims to swing it over  the leg side. Skewed off a thick leading edge over the covers for a flat six. Not middled, but no problem. The TV umpire has a look at it. Its a six alright..
pitched up and Nehra knocks on the doors of the channel of uncertainty, Gayle hangs back and swishes his bat out of the way
Chennai Super Kings set up final clash with Mumbai Indians. Fuller and on middle, Ashwin advances down the track and picks it away behind square on the leg side
Ranchi has been hushed into silence. Dhoni nicks off to DK, who makes no mistake now. Good length and outside off, Dhoni hunts for a powerful drive over the covers and feeds an outer edge to DK

low full toss on off, Dhoni drills a drive to the left of long-off. Kohli sprints across, swoops down the ball and lets a rip a throw to DK, who whips the bails off. But Dhoni is far too quick. The outcome is two
banged in short and outside off, Dhoni seeks to pull and manages an inside edge to the leg side off the pad
mighty full on off, Dhoni forces it down to long-off. Kohli fumbles and puts in a wayward throw. They pinch two after some hesitation between the wickets

Starc splinters the off stump, breaks it into two. DJ Bravo out for a golden duck. Starc goes ventures of the crease and spears it right in the blockhole, too hot for Bravo, who can't dig it out. Is the game still alive?

direct hit at the strikers', Negi walks off. Yorker at the base of off, jammed out to the covers. Dhoni rushes across for a quick single, Negi reciprocates. Sarfraz lasers a direct hit and ends Negi's cameo
angled in very full and on off, pushed back to Starc, who stretches his right hand and deflects it towards mid-off. Negi hustles across for the second
low full toss, tails in, hacked down to long-on
yorker at the base of off, jabbed to the covers. Sarfraz has an aim at the non-strikers' and misses.  The pair take the single they wanted via overthrow
length on off, Dhoni races down the track and lifts it over mid-off. Tense faces in the RCB camp
mighty full and outside off, Negi flat-bats it forcefully past the covers. Starc runs across to his left from sweeper cover and hunts it down
good length on off, Dhoni winds up and manages an inside edge onto the pad
full length on off, mistimed slog-sweep to long-on after sinking to one knee
hurled full and outside off, past the tram-line. Wide called
stump-to-stump line, Negi, who had initially backed away, adjusts and drives it past the covers
length and around off, Negi clears his front leg and has an almighty swipe at it. Walloped over deep midwicket
shortish, top-of-off line, steered square on the off side for one
good length on middle, pushed back to the bowler
122ks slower ball outside off, Dhoni can't connect with the dab. DK is beaten. His night has just gotten worse. Negi hares back for the third
back of a length and outside off, cracked to the right of deep third man

Wiese gets rid of Hussey. Crucial wicket for Royal Challengers. Short ball directed on a leg-stump line, tucks him up for room and messes with the attempted pull. He loops it to short fine leg off a top edge. Harshal takes a couple of steps back and snaps it up..
length on off, eased to the covers for one
slower length ball on middle, Hussey waits on it before dabbing it to deep third man
legbreak outside off with some extra bounce, Hussey gets on top of it and steers it to point
fifty up for Hussey. 100 up for CSK. He fetches this from outside off and slog-sweeps it over wide long-on into the second tier. That exploded from the meat of the bat
full on off, down the track and dragged to short midwicket off the inner part of the bat. He dives to his left and makes a smart stop
flatter on middle, Dhoni is tucked up for room. He manages to short-arm pull to long-on
Hussey flits down the track, takes it on the full and drives it to long-off
classy from Hussey! He charges down the track, manufactures a full ball and launches it over long-off. Clean strike
near yorker, swings in late. Whipped away through backward square leg
back of a length on middle, Dhoni sits back and plays a firm-handed push to the covers
too full on middle and leg, Hussey pootles a flick behind square on the leg side
pitched up on off, driven crisply down to long-off
width on offer outside off, Hussey skelps a drive to sweeper cover
pitched up and on off, Dhoni drills a drive straight down the ground
Dhoni nips down the track and yorks himself, jabbed down to long-on for one
wrong'un on off, Hussey aims to work to leg, gets a leading edge to the right of the bowler towards mid-off
darted outside off, Dhoni winds up and flat-bats it to long-off
flatter and quicker, spins away outside off. Pushed to the covers
flat and on the leg stump, nudged to the leg side
pushed through, spins in, googly. Poked out to the leg side
back of a length and outside off, Dhoni late-cuts it to deep third man
very full and on the pads, clipped to deep backward square leg
shortish and on the hips. Hussey latches onto it, picking it up fine on the leg side. The fielder in the deep was square and Hussey took advantage of it
shortish and outside off, Hussey switches his balance onto the back foot and cuts it towards sweeper cover
low full toss on middle, bunted to short midwicket, where Sarfraz dives to his right and makes a sharp save
flicked off the pads behind square on the leg side
back of a length and just a shade outside off, Hussey leans back and cuts it to Starc at sweeper cover
fuller and on middle, bunted down to long-on for a comfortable single
back of a length, stays low outside off. Hussey aims to cut and ends up chopping it behind point
banged in short and rises on Hussey, he goes for a pull and misses. Takes it on the body
That's a Hussey special. Pitched up and outside off, he leans into the drive and sends it scurrying in the gap at the covers
short and wide outside off, helped down to third man
canny slower bouncer outside off, dupes Hussey, who is early into a pull and fails to connect
width on offer outside off, Dhoni leans back and cuts it to deep third man
too full and outside off, mishit drive to the covers
short and rises on middle, blocked back to the bowler
full and outside off, Dhoni pushes it to point with firm hands
fuller and on middle, driven to mid-off for one
pitched up and outside off, driven past the covers
floated up and spins away outside off, rips past the groping bat of Hussey

Massive blow for Super Kings. Raina bags a duck. Tossed up, googly outside off, Raina attempts a lofted strike after dancing down the track, does not connect properly, slicing it to long-off. Wiese reverse-cups his hands around it. Kohli is off on a celebratory sprint. AB is pumped too
flatter and on middle, whipped to short midwicket
bowled 'em! This was a straight roller from Chahal, Faf goes low for a dinky lap-sweep and misses it entirely. Chahal rattles the leg stump.
pitched up and outside off, Hussey smears it over the covers. Starc runs across from deep cover, dives and pulls the ball back to Wiese, who was giving the chase from long-off
fuller and on the stumps, Faf presents a straight bat and drills it to the long-on boundary, beating Chahal to his left in the deep
length and outside off, Faf pre-meditates by shuffling across and laps it up to the fine leg boundary. Excellent improvisation
fullish and on middle, pushed to the covers, AB swoops down on the ball, tries to under-arm flick it onto the non-strikers' and misses. Hussey was a touch slow here
back of a length and outside off, not all that short. He cuts and does not connect
good length on off, driven down to long-on for one
width on offer outside off, Hussey reaches out and slices it over the covers
flat and fired on off, forced down to long-off
pushed through outside off, punched behind point for a quick single. Mandeep misses a direct hit
full and on off, Faf lashes it past the covers to long-off. Abdulla fumbles in the deep and gives away an extra run. The dew is making its presence felt
width on offer outside off, Hussey reaches out and slaps it past the covers
slid through quicker, looks like a googly. Hussey keeps it out
flatter and on middle, jammed in front of square leg. There is a communication breakdown in the middle. Poor throw from AB. A direct hit could have put Hussey in trouble
veering onto the pads, helped away to long leg
Did Faf get a scintilla of a tickle on it? Drifting down leg, Faf misses the glance, the ball brushes the pad. DK can't collect cleanly
on a length and outside off, pushed to point. Hussey comes halfway down the pitch in search of a single but is sent back
back of a length and outside off, Hussey leans back and cuts it to third man
back of a length and on middle and leg, tucked around the corner for one
fullish and just a shade outside off, Hussey has a lazy push at it and gets an outside edge, which is dropped by DK
back of a length and on off, Faf twirls his wrists and flicks it behind square on the leg side
sprays this well outside off, left alone. Wide called
back of a length and on off, he camps back and punches it to cover-point
back of a length and on off, punched to the covers, straight to the fielder
pitched up and outside off, Hussey presses forward and drives it to the covers
fuller and on off, Faf gets under it but mis-hits it over mid-on. Wiese sprints back, slides and hauls the ball into the field of play. They take three
good length ball on middle, worked to the leg side
pitched up and outside off, Hussey sets up for a cover-drive, but has to settle with an inside edge to mid-on
fuller and on off, Faf looks to drive but drags it to mid-on off the inner part of the bat
pitched up and on off at 114.2ks, slowy in pace. Tapped in front of point
back of a length and outside off, punched out to the covers off the back foot
slower ball outside off, driven to mid-off
banged in short and directed at the body, Hussey swivels through the hips and controls a pull fine on the leg side, wide of the man at deep backward square leg for a one-bounce four
low full toss dips just a shade outside off, Hussey pushes at it and the ball slips underneath his bat. This was the slower at 108ks
on a length and angling away, Faf has a crack at it and misses. He is beaten soundly
good length ball, pushed back to the bowler
back of length and on middle and leg, strikes Faf on the thigh
banged in short and just outside off, Hussey swivels through the hips and pulls it in the air. The ball dies down in front of an on-rushing Harshal. He could have attacked the ball more aggressively

Gayle drops it at first slip. This was on a length and angling away outside off, Aravind claims the outside edge, Gayle moves to his left, the ball hits him on the chest and spills down. That should have been taken..

Aravind strikes. Smith short-arm pulls and finds Mitch Starc. This was dropped short on middle and leg, Smith brings out his pet shot but hits is straight down the throat of Starc at deep square leg. He was cramped for room there
good length and on off, stops on Smith. He checks his drive and chips it in front of mid-off
back of a length and angling away outside off. Smith loads up for a pull and gets an toe end that skitters in the gap between between DK and Gayle at first slip
similar line and length, picked away between midwicket and mid-on
full and straight, flicked out to midwicket
back of a length and on off, turned towards square leg for one
too full and outside off, right in the zone for Smith. He comes forward and scythes it over the covers. The ball dribbles away to the boundary
length ball on middle, pressed into the covers for a single
back of a length and on off, Smith checks his drive and plays a jabbing punch over the non-striker, beating mid-off to his right
back of a length and on off, Smith hangs back and defends
back of a length and angled in on middle, dropped in front of the covers at one. AB runs in to attack the ball, but fails to gather it cleanly. The outcome is an easy single
on a length and outside off, Hussey presses forward and pushes it to cover-point
back of a length and angling away, pushed to the covers
mighty full and tails in sharply to strike Smith on the boot. But this was sliding down leg
inducker from Strac, Hussey reads it late and manages an inside edge onto the pads. The ball wanders away behind point
shortish and holds its line on off, dabbed in front of point
back of a length and curls away outside off, Hussey wafts and gets beaten as the ball skims past the outside edge. No feet movement from Hussey
inswinger from Starc on a fuller length, Smith closes his bat face and tucks it to the right of midwicket
back of a length and zipping through outside off, swings away late as Smith flails and misses. Excellent carry through to the keeper
